newsitem.title: CHINA: China pledges $1.0 bln to IMF package to Thailand.
newsitem.headline: China pledges $1.0 bln to IMF package to Thailand.

text.p: China has pledged to contribute $1.0 billion to an International Monetary Fund bailout for Thailand's financial crisis, central bank governor Dai Xianglong said on Thursday.
Dai said he had notified the International Monetary Fund (IMF) late on Wednesday of the decision by the People's Bank of China to contribute to the international bailout of Thailand.
Many currencies in the Southeast Asian region came under pressure after one-time tiger economy Thailand floated the baht last month in what amounted to a devaluation.

The IMF this week masterminded a $16 billion loan package to help Thailand out of its financial crisis. Japan and the IMF were the two biggest contributors to the package, offering $4.0 billion apiece.
